checkedAlternates.risk: The arrow nock clips directly onto the bowstring serving.
checkedAlternates.resolution: The nock is the rear end cap of the arrow (group-4), not the bowstring itself (group-1).

checkedAlternates.risk: The arrow rest bolts onto the central riser.
checkedAlternates.resolution: The arrow rest is an attachable aiming/launch accessory alongside the bow sight (group-2), whereas the riser, limbs, and stabilizer form the primary bow frame (group-3).

authorReview.notes: Author factual, ambiguity, and three-locale review complete.
